$comment: Design-system sidecar for DESIGN.md. Read by the impeccable design detector.
Why this file exists: the detector validates border-radius one CORNER at a time,
while this design system's unit of design is a four-corner asymmetric cut. A token
like chip ('3px 9px 5px 3px') is resolved to its first corner only, so its 5px and
9px corners read as undocumented drift, and 'pin' ('50%') is discarded outright
because percentage values are skipped. Both shape tokens in DESIGN.md frontmatter
are therefore inert on their own.
roundedMeta below declares the individual corner lengths the system actually uses,
grouped by the role each band plays, so the check compares like with like. This is
documentation of the Hand-Cut Sheet Rule in DESIGN.md, not a blanket waiver: values
outside these bands still surface. 55px is deliberately excluded — it is a one-off
in the codebase and should be reviewed rather than blessed.
Kept at the project root on purpose: .impeccable/ is gitignored, so a sidecar there
would silence findings on one machine and nowhere else.

control.role: Buttons and inputs. Exact, does not vary.

tab.role: Chapter tabs and month tabs. Exact, does not vary.

chip.role: Category and status marks. Exact, does not vary.

pin.note: Dates, compass points, rank markers, pins, and organic illustration blobs.

sheetTopLeft.role: Paper sheets: the quiet corner. Hand-varied 4-8px.

sheetTopRight.role: Paper sheets: the open corner that carries the hand-cut read. Varied 12-30px.

sheetBottom.role: Paper sheets: the clipped bottom pair. Varied 6-14px, or 0 where a sheet butts flush against an edge.
